atAGlance: Bì is shredded pork skin, usually with toasted rice powder, lean pork, herbs, and rice plates or rolls.
whatItIs: Bì is shredded pork skin mixed with thính, toasted rice powder, giving it a nutty aroma and fine, chewy texture. It appears in cơm tấm, rolls, and rice-paper plates.
howToEnjoy: Eat bì with rice, herbs, pickles, or rice paper so the toasted-rice aroma has contrast. It is rarely meant to be a plain standalone protein.
howLocalsOrder: Ask for bì when you want the shredded pork-skin topping, especially on cơm tấm or bì cuốn. If texture worries you, order a small portion first.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, thính is the hidden magic: toasted rice powder makes bì smell nutty instead of just “pork skin.”

orderLine.english: I’d like one order of shredded pork skin.
